name: google-tasks
description: Google Tasks (sensitive scope). Shares the `google-oauth` credential with google-sheets — connect once via the google-sheets plugin's 'Connect Google' button.

auth.label: Google (shared — connect via google-sheets)
auth.hint: Connect your own Google OAuth application in OrgSDK. The host refreshes tokens; plugins receive only a run-scoped access token.

marketplace.tagline: Create, update, and complete Google Tasks from agent workflows — turned into a durable task list your agents keep current.
useCases: Create tasks from emails, issues, or agent observations
Mark tasks complete and clear finished items on a schedule
Sync a task list to a sheet or report
Track follow-ups with due dates and notes
marketplace.permissionsSummary: Read, create, update, complete, and delete Google Tasks and task lists via OAuth. Reads are safe; creates, updates, and deletes are mutating.
